name: babylonjs-offline-game
description: A BabylonJS-powered offline game built with Parcel and Webpack.

scripts.start: npm run clean-assets && npm run prepare-assets && npm run build && start dist/index.html
scripts.build-wp: npm run prepare-assets-wp && webpack --config webpack.config.js --output-path dist-wp
scripts.zip: npm run prepare-assets-wp && webpack --config webpack.config.js --output-path dist-wp && powershell Compress-Archive -Path dist-wp -DestinationPath dist-wp.zip -Update
scripts.zip-parcel: npm run prepare-assets && npm run build && powershell Compress-Archive -Path dist -DestinationPath dist.zip -Update

author: Soumyadeep Das
